name: NGC 4559 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4559, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4559-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy in Coma Berenices whose disk holds young star clusters and a large star-forming complex in its outskirts. Hubble came to pick out its red giant stars and settle how far away it truly is.

claims.text: NGC 4559 (Caldwell 36) is a spiral galaxy in the constellation Coma Berenices
NGC 4559 has young star clusters away from its center and a large star-forming complex in its outskirts
Hubble program 13804 measures accurate tip-of-the-red-giant-branch distances to nearby SINGS spirals, including NGC 4559
